evidence_kind: Executed development pilot; one trial per variant/scenario
limitations: One development repetition; no held-out or statistical reliability claim.
Structured treatment adds an internal state tool/prompt while retaining full history.
Local checkpoint reconstruction is not AX suspend/resume.
Unsafe execution attribution remains unassessed; client logs are not independent API audit.
A published token-price estimate is not an observed bill.

pricing.assumptions: Published paid-tier standard token prices; actual account tier/credits/invoice unknown. No built-in grounding or explicit cache storage used. Infrastructure and any unpriced calls excluded.

release.structured_treatment: Additional incident state tool and prompt; full history retained
